title: PGP - Post Graduate Programme in Management
content: The Post Graduate Programme in Management (PGP) is ISB's flagship one-year, full-time residential programme. It is consistently ranked among the top business school programmes globally by the Financial Times. Mode: Residential, Full-time. Duration: 12 Months. Work experience required: 2+ years (minimum 24 months full-time post-qualification). Location: Hyderabad and Mohali campuses. The programme is designed to empower professionals with best-in-class knowledge, global perspectives and rich experiences. Approximately 820 students are admitted across both campuses annually. The Class of 2025 had 816 students enrolled across both campuses.

title: PGP Eligibility Criteria
content: To apply for the PGP, you must have: (1) A bachelor's degree or equivalent in any discipline (3-year or 4-year Indian degrees are both accepted; CA, CS qualifications are also accepted as equivalent). (2) A minimum of 24 months of full-time post-qualification work experience as of March 31 of the joining year. Internships, articleship prior to CA qualification, and part-time work do not count. (3) A valid GMAT, GMAT Focus Edition, or GRE score from a test centre only. Online or at-home scores are NOT accepted. (4) TOEFL or IELTS score if English was not the primary language of instruction for your undergraduate degree. There is no age limit. There is no published minimum CGPA, but admits below 6.5 CGPA are uncommon. Fresh graduates without 2 years of work experience are NOT eligible for the PGP.

title: PGP Application Deadlines for Class of 2028 (2026-2027 cycle)
content: ISB operates a staggered admission process with three rounds for the PGP Class of 2028 (2026-2027 cycle). Round 1 deadline: September 20, 2026. Round 2 deadline: December 6, 2026. Round 3 deadline: January 17, 2027. Applications submitted after a round deadline automatically roll into the next round. No applications accepted after January 17, 2027. The online application for each round opens approximately two months before the deadline. Recommender deadline for Round 1 is September 25, 2026. Interview timelines: Round 1 interviews 3rd/4th week of October to 4th week of November 2026. Round 2 interviews 1st week of January 2027 to 3rd week of February 2027. Round 3 interviews 2nd week of February 2027 to 2nd week of March 2027. Final decisions: Round 1 - End of November to Early December 2026. Round 2 - End of February 2027. Round 3 - Mid-March 2027. The programme for 2026-27 intake is tentatively scheduled to commence in April 2027.

title: Which PGP Round to Apply
content: ISB's official position is that the offer-to-application ratio is held proportional across Round 1 and Round 2. Round 1 is better if your application is ready, as it enables earlier planning and has the fullest scholarship pool. Round 1 candidates are eligible for the full tuition-fee waiver. Round 2 and Round 3 candidates are eligible for partial waivers, typically capped lower. Round 3 has limited seats and scholarships. Approximately 40% of applications arrive in Round 1 and 60% in Round 2. By Round 3, ISB has already filled the majority of class seats. Round 3 makes sense only if your profile has a strong differentiator or a real-life event blocked earlier rounds.

title: PGP Fees 2026-27 and 2027-28
content: PGP fee structure for 2026-27: Admission Fee (partially refundable) Rs 3,00,000 + 18% GST = Rs 3,54,000. Commitment Fee (non-refundable) Rs 2,00,000 + GST = Rs 2,36,000. Tuition Fee Rs 25,62,000. Accommodation: Shared Rs 2,34,000 or Studio Rs 5,16,000. Refundable Security Deposit Rs 20,000. Grand Total (single instalment, shared accommodation): Rs 38,67,160. Grand Total (studio accommodation): Rs 42,42,040. Other estimated expenses per year: approximately Rs 6,45,000 (books, laptop, meal plans, international programme, IT/laundry/electricity). For 2027-28 intake: Total with shared accommodation is approximately Rs 40,46,520. Total with studio accommodation is approximately Rs 44,45,000. The all-in cost including living expenses is approximately Rs 45-49 lakh. Fees can be paid in two instalments. Application fee is Rs 5,000 for Rounds 1 and 2, and Rs 7,000 for Round 3.

title: PGP Admission Process
content: The PGP admission process: (1) Register on the official portal and complete the online application before the deadline. (2) Submit academic transcripts, GMAT/GRE score, essays, professional recommendation, and application fee. (3) ISB verifies academic records, test scores, essays, and recommendation letters. (4) Shortlisted candidates are invited for an interview, which includes two on-the-spot essays. Interviews are conducted either in person at ISB campuses, at select cities, or virtually. Candidates are usually informed 3-7 days before the interview date. The interview lasts approximately 30 minutes. (5) After the interview, admission is finalised by a committee comprising ISB faculty and alumni. (6) Final decisions are communicated via email as per the round timeline. Accepted candidates must confirm acceptance and pay the admission fee within the stipulated timeframe.

title: PGP GMAT/GRE Score Requirements
content: ISB accepts GMAT, GMAT Focus Edition, and GRE scores for the PGP. Only test centre-based scores are accepted; online or at-home scores are NOT accepted. There is no published minimum or cutoff score. Based on historical data, admitted applicants have GMAT scores ranging from 605 to 785 with a median around 655-675. For GRE, scores range from 300 to 336 with a median around 325-327. Unofficial scores are accepted at the time of submission if the official test was taken on or before the round deadline; the official score must follow. ISB does not accept CAT scores for the PGP. There is no preference between GMAT and GRE - report the higher-percentile score.

title: PGP Required Documents
content: Documents required for the PGP application: (1) Academic documents: 10th marksheet, 12th marksheet, undergraduate degree certificate and transcripts. (2) GMAT/GRE score report. (3) Work experience documents: experience certificate, last three months' salary slips. (4) One professional recommendation/evaluation, preferably from a current or past supervisor or senior leader. (5) Two mandatory essays of 400 words each. (6) Identity proof: Aadhaar card or passport. (7) Recent photograph and signature. (8) Application fee payment. TOEFL/IELTS score if English was not the primary language of instruction.

title: PGP PRO - For Working Professionals
content: The Post Graduate Programme in Management for Working Professionals (PGP PRO) is a weekend Executive MBA (EMBA) equivalent programme for professionals with 5+ years of experience. Mode: Modular Format (weekend classes). Duration: 18 Months. Work experience required: 5+ years of full-time work experience. Location: Bengaluru, Delhi (NCR), Hyderabad, Mumbai. Fee: Rs 31,51,000 + GST (approximately Rs 37.18 lakh with GST). Eligibility: Bachelor's degree or equivalent in any discipline, 5+ years of full-time work experience. Round 1 deadline: August 23, 2026. The programme is equivalent in content and rigour to an Executive MBA. Participants receive a certificate of completion. No campus placement; Career Support Services are provided.

title: PGP MAX - For Senior Executives
content: The Post Graduate Programme in Management for Senior Executives (PGP MAX) is a global EMBA equivalent programme for senior executives and business owners. Mode: Flexible, Modular, Global. Duration: 15 Months. Work experience required: 10+ years of full-time work experience after graduation. Location: Hyderabad and Mohali. Fee: approximately Rs 41.78 lakh + GST (all-in approximately Rs 49.30 lakh). Eligibility: Bachelor's degree or equivalent (CA, ICWA accepted), 10+ years full-time work experience. The programme involves 12 weeks of on-campus learning (approximately 1 week every 6 weeks) plus an international study component. Round 1 deadline: August 20, 2026. Designed for C-suite preparation, directors, CXOs, and entrepreneurs.

title: PGP MFAB - For Family Business
content: The Post Graduate Programme in Management for Family Business (PGP MFAB) is designed for next-generation family business owners and successors. Mode: Modular Format. Duration: 15 Months. Work experience: 0 years minimum (preferred 2+ years in family business). Location: Hyderabad and Mohali. Fee for 2027-28: Rs 44,72,881 + GST (total programme fee inclusive of security deposit and GST: Rs 52,98,000). This fee includes tuition, course materials, meals, accommodation during residencies, lodging for the international immersion programme, and lifetime access to the Learning Resource Centre and recreation centre. Eligibility: Bachelor's degree or equivalent. Round 1 deadline: November 29, 2026.

title: PGP YL - Young Leaders Programme
content: The Post Graduate Programme for Young Leaders (PGP YL) is designed for high-potential early-career professionals and fresh graduates. Mode: Residential, Full-time. Duration: 20 Months. Work experience: 0-2 years (0-24 months). Location: Hyderabad Campus only. Fee: approximately Rs 21.65 lakh + GST (all-in approximately Rs 29.70 lakh). Eligibility: Bachelor's degree, 0-24 months of work experience. Accepts GMAT, GRE, or CAT scores. For CAT, a percentile of 97-99 is generally competitive. Round 1 deadline: December 20, 2026.

title: FPM - Fellow Programme in Management
content: The Fellow Programme in Management (FPM) is ISB's doctoral programme, equivalent to a PhD. Duration: 4-5 years. Mode: Full-time. A stipend is provided to fellows. Contact: fellow@isb.edu. ISB also offers an Executive Fellow Programme in Management (EFPM) for working professionals. Duration: 3 years. Mode: Part-time. Fee: INR 47 Lacs + GST. Contact for pre-doctoral programme: predoctoral@isb.edu.

title: Advanced Management Programmes (AMPs)
content: ISB offers several Advanced Management Programmes (AMPs) for domain specialisation. Duration: 12-15 months. Mode: Hybrid. Fee range: Rs 10.65-14.01 lakh. Available AMPs include: AMPBA (Business Analytics) - 15 months; AMPH (Healthcare) - 12 months; AMPI (Infrastructure) - 12 months; AMPOS (Operations and Supply Chain) - 12 months; AMPPP (Public Policy) - 12 months.

title: I-Venture Immersive (IVI)
content: The I-Venture Immersive (IVI) is ISB's entrepreneurship programme for startup founders. Duration: 6 months. Mode: Full-time residential. Fee: approximately Rs 5.9 lakh + GST. Designed for founders at any stage. Phase 2 includes up to Rs 40 lakh funding opportunity.

title: ISB Scholarships
content: ISB offers scholarships to PGP students. Between 40-50% of the class receives scholarship support. Round 1 candidates are eligible for the full tuition-fee waiver. Round 2 and Round 3 candidates are eligible for partial waivers, typically capped lower. ISB has banking partnerships with Canara Bank for education loans. Maximum eligible loan for ISB students: up to Rs 50 lakh. Repayment in EMIs up to 15 years excluding the moratorium period (course duration + 1 year). No prepayment penalty during the repayment period.

title: About ISB - Indian School of Business
content: The Indian School of Business (ISB) is one of India's top private business and management schools, established in 2001. ISB has two campuses: Hyderabad (main campus, established 2001) and Mohali (established 2012). ISB is consistently ranked among the top business schools globally by the Financial Times. The mission of ISB is to groom future leaders for India and the world. ISB's Class of 2024 reported an average compensation of Rs 34.21-37.29 lakh per annum.

title: Work Experience Requirements - Common Questions
content: The 24-month rule is counted from the day you began full-time employment after your qualifying degree. Internships do not count. CA articleship prior to qualification does not count. Gap years between graduation and first job do not count. If you have 22 months of work experience and your 24-month mark falls after March 31 of the joining year, you are NOT eligible for that cycle - apply the following year. ISB verifies all work experience post-admission through an independent agency. Three-year Indian bachelor's degrees are fully acceptable.

title: Can Fresh Graduates Apply?
content: Fresh graduates (without 2 years of work experience) are NOT eligible for the flagship PGP programme. However, fresh graduates can apply for: (1) PGP YL (Young Leaders) - designed for 0-2 years of work experience, even freshers can apply. (2) PGP MFAB - for family business, 0 years minimum experience (2 years preferred).

title: Does ISB Accept CAT Scores?
content: For the main PGP programme, ISB does NOT accept CAT scores. ISB PGP requires GMAT or GRE scores only. However, CAT scores are accepted for the PGP Young Leaders (PGP YL) programme, for candidates with up to 24 months of work experience. A CAT percentile of 97-99 is generally competitive for PGP YL. For PGPpro, PGP MAX, and PGP MFAB, selection is profile-based with interviews; GMAT/GRE is not always required.

title: Education Loan for ISB
content: ISB has banking partnerships for education loans, including with Canara Bank. Maximum eligible loan for ISB students: up to Rs 50 lakh. Repayment in EMIs up to 15 years excluding the moratorium period (course duration + 1 year). No prepayment penalty during the repayment period. The loan typically covers tuition, accommodation, and living expenses.

title: ISB Programmes Summary
content: ISB Programme Comparison: (1) PGP: 12 months, 2+ years experience, Full-time residential, Hyderabad & Mohali, Fee Rs 38.67-42.42 lakh. (2) PGP YL: 20 months, 0-2 years experience, Full-time residential, Hyderabad, Fee ~Rs 21.65 lakh + GST. (3) PGP PRO: 18 months, 5+ years experience, Weekend modular, Bengaluru/Delhi/Hyderabad/Mumbai, Fee Rs 31.51 lakh + GST. (4) PGP MAX: 15 months, 10+ years experience, Executive modular, Hyderabad & Mohali, Fee ~Rs 41.78 lakh + GST. (5) PGP MFAB: 15 months, 0+ years (family business), Modular, Hyderabad & Mohali, Fee ~Rs 42.13 lakh + GST. (6) IVI: 6 months, Any (founders), Full-time residential, Fee ~Rs 5.9 lakh + GST. (7) FPM: 4-5 years, Academic, Full-time, Stipend provided. (8) EFPM: 3 years, Working professionals, Part-time, Fee ~Rs 47 lakh + GST. (9) AMPs: 12-15 months, 2-12+ years, Hybrid, Fee Rs 10.65-14.01 lakh.
